summary: Frontend-only verification of the two fixes: (1) Checkout no longer crashes on address/phone input & browser autofill (TDZ ReferenceError fixed by reordering allowedPostalCodes/postalIsServed before canSubmit). (2) Kids menu now renders a two-option builder (Choix du plat) with large bt-option cards and an 'Inclus dans le menu' block. Both scenarios verified end-to-end including a live order submission that succeeded.

test_results.checkout_no_crash_on_autofill: PASS - filled phone/first/last, switched to delivery, filled address1/postal(06240)/city(Beausoleil) in rapid succession; no pageerror, no console TDZ error, form remained mounted, submit became enabled.
test_results.checkout_submit_flow: PASS - pickup + cash submit hit POST /api/checkout/session, redirected to /order/success?order_id=34831a48-... , pickup code 5585 displayed.
test_results.kids_menu_builder: PASS - 'Choix du plat' label present, two bt-option cards (item-<id>-format-5 Nuggets & item-<id>-format-1 Cheeseburger) each showing 8,00 €, 'Inclus dans le menu' block with 'Frites · Capri-Sun · Kinder Maxi · Compote'. Selecting Cheeseburger toggled selected class and added to cart at 8,00 €.
test_results.non_kids_format_unchanged: PASS - Sodas 33cl still uses bt-chip 'Format' label, no 'Choix du plat', no 'Inclus dans le menu'.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console shows a single 'Failed to load resource: 400' during checkout quote calls when required fields aren't yet populated — /api/checkout/quote is being called on every keystroke and the backend rejects some payloads (e.g. postal-not-served, empty items during transitions). Consider debouncing or catching silently client-side so the browser console stays clean. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded 'Menu Kids' and 'Sodas 33cl'.

Order submission works while restaurant state=open. Only remaining minor observation is noisy 400s from /api/checkout/quote during transient form states.
